title: Circuit board thermal explorer
line: Change chip power and air temperature and re-solve a board's temperature.
description: An app that solves the steady temperature of a 120 by 80 mm circuit board carrying three chips and cooled by air on both faces. A slider sets the processor power, an edit field the air temperature and a pop-up menu the colormap; the 3-D surface, isotherms and a section plot update on each change.
thumbnailAlt: An app window with operating-point controls and results beside a 3-D temperature surface of a circuit board, its isotherms and a temperature section, rendered by RunMat
